data.name: Ginelle
data.long_meaning: Ginelle is a French name derived from the word ginestre, meaning 'juniper'. In medieval France, juniper was associated with the Virgin Mary and was believed to protect against evil. The name Ginelle thus carries the spiritual significance of a precious and protected child of God.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the preciousness and protection of a beloved child of God.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with a life path number 3 are creative, expressive, and social. They are often natural communicators and love the arts. They may be versatile, artistic, and spontaneous.
data.cultural_impact: Historically in medieval France, the name Ginelle was popular specifically due to the association of juniper with the Virgin Mary. It was believed that this fragrant plant protected against evil forces and offered a sacred space, making it an ideal name for a child.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ginelle radiates a sense of protection and safety, as it is derived from the name ginestre, which was used to honor the Virgin Mary and her divine protection in medieval France. It signifies the child as a precious and cherished gift from God, deserving of love, care, and spiritual guidance.
